correctness.rationale: Identity (1) follows exact finite-subspace Möbius inversion; the seven-by-seven Fano incidence matrix gives the four-column-plane obstruction for all nonsimplex inputs. The strict all-t>=7 comparison is analytic using 4^7>7*3^7. An exhaustive check of all 3432 possible seven-column multisets, including all 2696 full-rank ones, reconstructs their t=1..6 failure counts by both Möbius counting and independently coded subspace-state DP; it verifies strict t=3..6 and the exact minima 24,192,1080,5280 with 42 minimizers each. No finite check is passed off as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Retrieval under an arbitrary observation deadline is a natural reliability objective distinct from mean retrieval time. A stochastic minimum at every deadline optimizes all increasing waiting-time costs and distinguishes a unique seven-strand geometry. The 42 sharp nearest competitors quantify nontrivial finite-time stability; the bounded census completes precisely the cases left by a structural obstruction valid at all larger times.
